name: sparx — Roofing (Storm)
tagline: A bold, storm-ready template for roofers — book inspections online from day one.
description: A bold storm-damage and exteriors template — a deep-graphite palette with a sharp signal-red accent and condensed type. Installs a working booking spine for storm inspections and insurance claims: free inspections, claim consults, roof/siding/window estimates and an emergency tarp visit, with three roofers dispatched by skill on their own weekly hours and a priority policy. Ships as "Ironclad Roofing & Exteriors".
